column3: `supervise.py mode --request TEXT [--token TOK ...]` prints `[MOL-MODE]`, plus `[MOL-NEXT] next="generation only; offer `run` once the launcher exists"` when the mode is `generate`; always exit 0
`supervise.py learning --request TEXT [--token TOK ...]` prints `[MOL-LEARNING]`, plus a `[MOL-NEXT]` bootstrap hint when the mode is `apply`; always exit 0
`supervise.py resolve --repo DIR [--feature SLUG] [--launcher PATH]` prints `[MOL-LAUNCHER]` (exit 0) or `[MOL-REFUSE] action=resolve` (exit 4)
`supervise.py gate --launcher PATH [--implement] [--smoke]` prints every gate check and the decision; exit 0 only for decision `launch`, exit 4 for `refuse` AND for `attach`

`supervise.py launch --launcher PATH [--mode run|auto] [--implement] [--smoke]` gates then starts the launcher detached and prints `[MOL-LAUNCH]`; `--mode` default `run`; exit 4 when the gate does not say `launch`
`supervise.py watch (--launcher PATH | --run-dir DIR) [cadence]` supervises an already launched run until terminal or expiry

`supervise.py observe (--launcher|--run-dir) [cadence] [--json]` takes one reading; when terminal prints `[MOL-DIGEST]` and may relaunch (then exit 0); otherwise prints `[MOL-NEXT] poll-in=<s>s` and exits 0
`supervise.py auto --launcher PATH [--mode run|auto] [--implement] [--smoke] [cadence]` = `launch` then `watch` in one call; `--mode` default `auto`

`supervise.py stop (--launcher|--run-dir) [cadence]` records the stop request, sends SIGTERM to the process group, prints `[MOL-STOP]`, then supervises without relaunch with base poll `min(poll, 5)` and max wait 120 s by default
`supervise.py retro (--launcher|--run-dir)` writes a read-only retrospective; always exit 0
Cadence flag `--poll-seconds` default 60
Cadence flag `--max-poll-seconds` default 600
Cadence flag `--max-wait-seconds` default none = the contract's declared supervision ceiling measured from the first launch
Cadence flag `--no-relaunch`: report a classified transient instead of relaunching it
`observe --json` additionally prints the raw observation as sorted JSON on stdout (not mirrored to the report log)
`--launcher` and `--run-dir` are mutually exclusive and one is required; `gate`, `launch` and `auto` accept only `--launcher`
`supervise.py` exit map: completed 0, stopped 2, unknown-terminal 3, refused 4, supervision-expired 5, failed 22, lock-conflict 24; any other status 1
`supervise.py` exit 4 with `[MOL-REFUSE] action=<command> reason=<SupervisorError reason>` on any `SupervisorError`
`supervise.py` exit 4 with `[MOL-REFUSE] ... reason=invalid-contract` on a `ContractError` outside the gate
`supervise.py` exit 130 with `[MOL-REFUSE] ... reason=interrupted detail="supervision was interrupted; the run was left alone"` on KeyboardInterrupt
`supervise.py` exit 2 on argparse usage errors (missing subcommand, unknown flag)
Mode tokens `--auto`, `--run`, `--generate` (from `--token` or found in the request text by `(?<!\S)--[a-z-]+`) win over all prose; the first matching token in order decides

Refusal phrases (10 regexes: `don't|do not run/execute/launch/start`, `without running...`, `no execution`, `don't auto`, `just|only derive/generate/...`, `... only`, `generation only`, `dry-run only`, `no auto`) yield `generate` with source `refusal`
A bare `dry-run`/`dry run` mention without an auto phrase yields `generate` with source `refusal` evidence `dry-run`
Auto phrases (`auto`, `auto-mode`, `<generation verb> ... and (then) run|execute`, `... then run|launch|execute`) yield `auto` with source `prose`

Run phrases (`run it|this|that|them`, `run the pipeline|launcher|run script|script|loop|stage(s)`, `execute|launch|start|kick off it/this/that/the X`, `resume the run|pipeline`, `for real`, `then run`, `and run it`) yield `run`, or `auto` when a generation word is also present
Default mode is `generate` with source `default` and empty evidence
`implement`/`smoke` flags are read from tokens `--implement`/`--smoke` or phrases `with --implement`, `implement setup`, `with --smoke`, `smoke stage(s)`
`[MOL-MODE] mode=<m> source=<token|refusal|prose|default> evidence=<json string> flags=<json string>`
Learning tokens `--learning-off|--learning-suggest|--learning-apply` win; then refusal phrases -> `off`; then apply phrases -> `apply`; then suggest phrases -> `suggest`; default `off`
`[MOL-LEARNING] mode=<off|suggest|apply> source=<...> evidence=<json string>`

Launcher resolution order: requested path (relative to repo) -> `<repo>/.mixture-of-loops/<slug>/run-<slug>.sh` -> the single file in the repo whose first 400 bytes contain `# mixture-of-loops-generated:` (skipping `.git`, symlinks, `.mixture-of-loops/generated` and `.mixture-of-loops/runs`)
Resolve refusal reason `launcher-not-found`
Resolve refusal reason `launcher-missing`
Resolve refusal reason `launcher-ambiguous`
`[MOL-LAUNCHER] launcher=<path> source=<request|feature-default|generated-marker>`
Resolve refusal line `[MOL-REFUSE] action=resolve reason=<r> detail=<json> next="ask for `auto` to generate the launcher first"`
Bundle read error reasons `launcher-unreadable` and `launcher-not-generated` (no `BUNDLE_DIR="$SCRIPT_DIR/..."` line)

Gate checks in fixed order: `launcher-intact`, `contract-validated`, `authorized-root`, `launcher-syntax`, `launcher-dry-run`, `run-directory-free`; first failure decides, later checks reported `not-evaluated`
Gate reason `launcher-not-found` (check `launcher-intact`)
Gate reason `launcher-edited` (check `launcher-intact`)
Gate reason `learning-decisions-changed` (check `contract-validated`)
Gate reason `stale-sources` (check `contract-validated`)
Gate reasons `open-blocker`, `draft-contract`, `invalid-contract`, chosen by SUBSTRING match on the validation error text (`open blocker`, `status must be validated`)
Gate reason `unauthorized-root` (check `authorized-root`)
Gate reason `launcher-syntax-error` (`bash -n` failed; detail is the first 400 chars of stderr)
Gate reason `dry-run-failed` (launcher `--dry-run --no-color` non-zero within 300 s; detail is the last 400 chars of output)
Gate reason `already-running` with decision `attach` (run directory lock held)
`run-directory-free` probes by taking and releasing a non-blocking flock on `runs/<id>/lock`; a missing or unopenable lock file counts as free
The gate's dry run passes `--implement`/`--smoke` through and sets `NO_COLOR=1`, `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1`, stdin closed, new session, cwd = launcher directory
`[MOL-GATE] check=<name> status=<pass|fail|not-evaluated>[ reason=<r> detail=<json>]`; detail is printed only when a reason is set, so pass-check details are never shown
`[MOL-GATE] decision=<launch|refuse|attach>[ reason=<r>][ detail=<json>][ next=<json>]`
Launch argv is `[<launcher>, --no-color][, --implement][, --smoke]`, never a shell string
The supervisor sets `NO_COLOR=1` and `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1` on launch, relaunch and the gate dry run
Detached launch: stdin `/dev/null`, stdout+stderr appended to `harness-launch.log`, `start_new_session=True`, cwd = launcher directory
`runs/<id>/harness-launch.log`: append; each launch writes a header `=== launch <%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z> <argv> ===`, each relaunch `=== relaunch ... ===`

`runs/<id>/harness-run.json` (schema `mixture-of-loops/harness-run/1`), atomic; fields `schema pipeline mode launcher argv cwd contract bundle cmdline_markers contract_digest flags pid pgid launched_at first_launched_at launcher_log_offset run_dir state_path launcher_log launch_log report_log stage_count relaunch_budget relaunches supervision` (+ `stop_requested`)
`relaunch_budget` fields: `max_relaunches remaining wall_clock_seconds deadline declared_pipeline_seconds source`; the deadline is fixed at first launch and not extended by relaunches
`runs/<id>/harness-report.log`: every `[MOL-*]` line is appended once a run directory is known; write failures are ignored
`[MOL-LAUNCH] pipeline= mode= launcher= run-dir= stages= flags=<json> relaunch-budget=<remaining>/<max> (<source>) wall-clock-ceiling=<g>s pid= stop="kill -TERM -<pgid>"`

Observation authority order: `state.json`, then PID liveness, then labelled lines of `launcher.log` from the offset recorded at launch, then Specstride's newest stop reason, then the last 2000 bytes of `harness-launch.log`

`[DIGEST]` is parsed with `^\[DIGEST\] state=(\S+) exit=(-?\d+) last-stage=(\S+)(?: child-exit=(\S+))? evidence=(.*)$`; `child-exit=None` reads as null; the newest DIGEST in launcher.log wins, else the newest in the launch-log tail
Labelled lines are recognised by `^\[([A-Z][A-Z-]*)\] (.*)$`

Status derivation: alive -> `running` when state is `ready|running` else `starting`; not alive and launcher exit 24 -> `lock-conflict`; state `completed|failed|stopped` -> that; else from launcher exit (0 completed, >=128 stopped, other failed); else `unknown-terminal`

PID liveness: own child handle first; else `kill(pid, 0)` (PermissionError counts as alive); where `/proc/<pid>/cmdline` exists one recorded marker (launcher path or bundle dir name) must appear; without `/proc` (macOS) a reused PID reads as alive
Observation `detail` is the newest `RECOVER|BLOCKED|RESUME|ERROR|FAIL` labelled line as `<LABEL>: <message>`
The supervisor reads Specstride's newest stop reason from the stage's `recovery.reason.jsonl` from offset 0 (whole file), unlike the runtime which reads from the pre-attempt offset
Stage elapsed is clamped to [0, total elapsed]; total elapsed counts from `first_launched_at`
`[MOL-STATE] pipeline= stage=<i>/<n> id=<id|none> state=<status> stage-elapsed=<Ns|-> total-elapsed=<Ns>[ detail=<json>]` printed when the observation signature changed
`[MOL-HOLD] pipeline= unchanged=<count> stage=<i>/<n> id= state= total-elapsed=` printed for each unchanged observation
Change signature = (status, run_state, stage_id, stage_index, stage_reason, detail, launcher_exit); clocks excluded
Poll interval: returns to base on a change or when detail starts with `RECOVER`; otherwise previous x 1.5 capped at the max
Supervision state (`interval unchanged signature`) is persisted in `harness-run.json` after every non-terminal reading and cleared at terminal, so `observe` wake-ups agree with a continuous `watch`

Supervision expiry: when now + next interval would pass the deadline, prints `[MOL-REFUSE] action=supervise reason=supervision-expired` and a `[MOL-DIGEST]`, leaves the run running, status `supervision-expired` (exit 5)
`[MOL-ANOMALY] pipeline= detail=<json>` per anomaly; for `unknown-terminal` also `[MOL-ANOMALY] pipeline= launch-log=<json of last 600 chars>`
`[MOL-DIGEST] pipeline= state= exit=<int|unknown> child-exit=<int|none> last-stage=<id|none> evidence=<path> state-path=<path> next=<json>`
Digest `next` text: `relaunch: <detail>` when relaunching; `no relaunch (<reason>): <detail>` for a failed run; otherwise the fixed `NEXT_ACTION` text per status
`[MOL-REFUSE] action=<a> reason=<r> detail=<json>[ next=<json>]`
`[MOL-NEXT] poll-in=<g>s` after a non-terminal `observe` and after an `observe` relaunch
Relaunch refusal `still-running`
Relaunch refusal `operator-stop` (a stop was requested through `supervise.py stop`)
Relaunch refusal `completed`
Relaunch refusal `deliberate-stop` (state `stopped`: signal or child exit 6)
Relaunch refusal `unknown-terminal`
Relaunch refusal `lock-conflict`
Relaunch refusal `unknown-launcher-exit` (no DIGEST recorded an exit)
Relaunch refusal `signal-stop` (launcher exit >= 128)
Relaunch refusals by launcher exit: `invalid-contract` (20), `preflight-blocked` (21), `stale-sources` (23), `lock-conflict` (24), else `launcher-exit-<n>`
Relaunch refusal `state-not-failed`
Relaunch refusal `unknown-stage`
Relaunch refusals mapped from deliberate stage reasons: `postcondition-failure`, `stage-precondition`, `setup-required`, `interrupted`, `stage-did-not-run`, `stage-did-not-fail`
Relaunch refusal `exec-error` (stage reason starts with `exec-error`)
Relaunch refusal `stage-reason-not-transient`; transient stage reasons are exactly `exit`, `timeout`, `recovery-deadline`, `recovery-exhausted`
Relaunch refusal `child-exit-not-retryable`
Relaunch refusal `stop-reason-not-allowed` (Specstride's newest `run_stop.reason`, matched by string, is not in `recovery.reason.allowed`)
Relaunch refusal `contract-digest-changed` (state bound to another digest, or the launcher now points at another contract)
Relaunch refusal `learning-decisions-changed`
Relaunch refusal `launcher-edited`
Relaunch refusal `budget-exhausted`
Relaunch refusal `budget-deadline-exceeded`
Relaunch refusal `relaunch-disabled` (`--no-relaunch`)
Relaunch approval reason `classified-transient`
Classifier conditions are evaluated in a fixed order, so the FIRST failing condition names the refusal; the order is part of the observable output

Relaunch re-invokes the recorded argv in the recorded cwd with the supervisor's CURRENT environment (not the launch environment), decrements `remaining`, appends `{reason detail launcher_exit child_exit stage stage_reason stop_reason at pid remaining}` to `relaunches`, resets supervision

`[MOL-RELAUNCH] pipeline= attempt=<n>/<max> reason= exit= child-exit= stage= stop-reason=<python repr> budget-remaining= detail=<json>`; `stop-reason` is a Python repr (single quotes, or `None`), not JSON

`auto` mode and `run` mode are recorded in `harness-run.json` and `[MOL-LAUNCH]` only; no code path in the supervisor branches on the mode value, so supervision and relaunch behave identically in both
Stop: writes `stop_requested {signal, at}` to `harness-run.json` BEFORE signalling, sends SIGTERM to the recorded process group; no SIGKILL escalation
`[MOL-STOP] pipeline=<id> sent=<true|false> detail=<json>`; when nothing could be signalled the command exits 0 without supervising
`runs/<id>/retrospectives/<semantic contract digest>.json` (schema `mol.retrospective/1`), atomic; fields `schema pipeline contract_digest generated_at stages`

Retro per `specstride` stage runs `<argv0> learn -w <workdir> --feature <slug> --summarize|--evaluate` (after probing each with `--help`), 120 s timeout, learning env stripped; any failure yields status `unavailable` with a reason
Retro locates the feature from the first of `recovery.reason.jsonl`, `evidence[0]`, or a postcondition path matching `(.specstride|.wiggum)/features/<slug>`
Retro suggestions are derived by matching `[<id>]: regressed` in `learn --evaluate` output and rendered as `<argv0> learn -w <workdir> --feature <slug> --revert <id>`
`[MOL-RETRO] pipeline= stage= status=<ok|unavailable> detail=<json> path=<file>`, followed by `[MOL-RETRO]   <evaluation line>` lines
`[MOL-RETRO] status=unavailable reason="the contract behind the launcher cannot be read"` and `... reason="no specstride stage"`

column3: `[MOL-NEXT] suggestion (not run): <command>`
`bin/onboard-skill --harness codex|claude|dsh|pi|prime|all --scope user|repo` links the canonical skill directory
`onboard-skill --repo DIR` (default current directory) for `--scope repo`
`onboard-skill --check` verifies without changing the filesystem
`onboard-skill --repair` replaces an existing symlink that points elsewhere (ignored when `--check` is also set)
`onboard-skill` exit 2: unknown option, or missing/invalid `--harness` or `--scope`
`onboard-skill` exit 3: canonical `SKILL.md` missing, or repository is not a directory
`onboard-skill` exit 4: existing link points elsewhere (without `--repair`) or a real path is in the way
`onboard-skill` exit 5: link missing under `--check`
`onboard-skill` exit 6: a different `mixture-of-loops` skill is visible to pi or prime
`onboard-skill` exit 7: pi project untrusted, only under `--check` (strict) and only when no other failure occurred
`onboard-skill` exit 1 can occur under `set -euo pipefail` with `--harness all` when `install_one codex` or `claude` fails (the script aborts with that function's status 4 or 5)
`<harness>: ok -> <source>` / `<harness>: linked <target> -> <source>` on stdout
`<harness>: existing link points elsewhere[ (broken)]: <target> -> <link>` and `<harness>: missing: <target>` on stderr
`dsh: shared through the Codex-compatible .agents/skills link (one discovery entry)` and `<pi|prime>: shared through the .agents/skills link (one discovery entry)` under `--harness all`
`--harness all` links codex and claude, links dsh separately only for user scope with a non-default `DSH_AGENTS_HOME`, and never links pi or prime (they are reported only)

`HOME` required; `DSH_HOME` (default `$HOME/.dsh`); `DSH_AGENTS_HOME` (default `$HOME/.agents`); `PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR` (default `$HOME/.pi/agent`); `PRIME_AGENT_CODING_AGENT_DIR` (default `$HOME/.prime/agent`); leading `~/` expanded for the last two
Link targets per harness and scope: `.agents/skills`, `.claude/skills`, `.dsh/skills`, `.pi/skills` (repo) or `<agent dir>/skills` (user), `.prime/agent/skills`

Collision scan mirrors the pi/prime loaders: repo config skills dir, `.agents/skills` from the repo up to the git root, `settings.json` `skills` entries (plain paths only), agent dir skills and `$HOME/.agents/skills`; reads front-matter `name:`
pi trust check: nearest `trust.json` entry walking up from the repo; else `settings.json` `defaultProjectTrust == always`
Skill rule: a request that does not ask for execution gets `generate` (Silence is not consent to execute) and the closing message offers `run`
column5: Silence is not consent to execute

column3: Skill rule: default launcher path `.mixture-of-loops/run-<feature>.sh`; every generated artifact lives under `.mixture-of-loops/` with the contract at `.mixture-of-loops/<feature>/launch-contract.json`
Skill rule: before writing any artifact the host appends six ignore rules for `.mixture-of-loops/` to `.gitignore` (or `.git/info/exclude`), idempotently, and says which file received them
Skill rule: Specstride's verification plan is written to `.mixture-of-loops/<feature>/verification-commands.json` and passed with `--verification-commands`
Skill rule: the host never searches for or runs `specstride`, never reads outside the repository and `SKILL_ROOT`; installation is reported by the dry run's `[PREFLIGHT]` lines
Skill rule: the host relays `[MOL-*]` lines verbatim, never reads `state.json` or logs to report an outcome itself, and recovers lost output from `harness-report.log` or by repeating `observe`
column5: Relay the `[MOL-*]` lines as they are printed

column3: Skill rule: the host never edits a launcher, never passes `--replace-edited`, never runs `specstride learn --apply|--revert|--off`, never writes `status` itself
Skill rule: in `generate` the work ends after `bash -n` and `--dry-run`; a `fail` in `[PREFLIGHT]` is not a generation failure
